architectural_lifecycle.name: Discovery & Audit
architectural_lifecycle.deliverables: Deep-dive audit into workflows, codebases, and technical debt. Identification of invisible friction points and bottleneck analysis.

architectural_lifecycle.name: Strategy & Blueprinting
architectural_lifecycle.deliverables: Custom architectural roadmap mapping system logic, AI integration points, data pipelines, and cloud scalability modules.

architectural_lifecycle.name: High-Fidelity Design
architectural_lifecycle.deliverables: Cinematic, user-centric prototypes turning complex technical workflows into intuitive, high-conversion human experiences.

architectural_lifecycle.name: Technical Implementation
architectural_lifecycle.deliverables: Sprint-based engineering of robust AI engines, backend microservices, resilient APIs, and production frontend code.

architectural_lifecycle.name: Quality & Integrity Check
architectural_lifecycle.deliverables: Rigorous automated testing, security vulnerability scans, load stress-testing, and compliance verification.

architectural_lifecycle.name: Deployment & Evolution
architectural_lifecycle.deliverables: Zero-downtime production deployment, real-time observability telemetry, and ROI-driven continuous iteration.
